tool_call_proposal.name: lookup_order
tool_call_proposal.why: The customer supplied an order number and the shipping status determines the next action.

turn_3_final_triage.rationale: Order CTG-ORD-884120 shows a Summit 2 Tent purchased 2026-05-02; the customer reports tracking stalled for six days, which is a shipping issue rather than a product defect.

simulated_tool_result.message: No matching order in the synthetic workshop dataset.

expected_model_behaviour.rationale: The order lookup returned order_not_found, so no purchase details are confirmed. Ask the customer to confirm the order number rather than assuming a record exists.

anti_patterns_to_call_out: Inventing an order record after a failed lookup
Claiming the ticket was created when only a proposal was emitted

tool_call_proposal.name: create_support_ticket

arguments.summary: Customer reports a sleeping bag zipper that separates nightly on a bag purchased about two years ago; warranty eligibility not confirmed.

tool_call_proposal.why: A human warranty reviewer must decide eligibility; the ticket routes the case to them.

write_action_proposal_example.reminder: Approval is enforced by the application, not by the wording of the prompt.
